title: 'Dancing With the Stars' recap: Maura Higgins is surprise standout on second night of Season 35 premiere event - NewsBreak
text:
By Daniel Montgomery ,
5 hours ago Dancing With the Stars premiered last night with its eight male celebrities performing their first routines. Tonight, it's the women's turn. How does the field of ladies compare to their masculine counterparts? 'American Idol' leaves Hollywood for Georgia in Season 25 shake-up It was perhaps to be expected that former professional background dancer and Glee alum Harry Shum Jr. rose to the occasion on Tuesday night. He topped the judges' leaderboard with sevens across the board for a total of 21 out of 30. Paralympian Ezra Frech and Bachelorette contestant Tyler Cameron also received strong marks for their debut routines. Unfortunately, Jimmy Kimmel Live sidekick Guillermo Rodriguez was stuck at the bottom of the list with a combined score of 10. But Guillermo wasn't the celeb sent home, perhaps indicating a strong voting base that will carry him through the season. Instead, Secret Lives of Mormon Wives cast member Conner Leavitt was eliminated, unable to match the sixth-place finish of his wife Whitney, who competed on the show last year. Well this sucks, Conner went home 😢 #DWTS pic.twitter.com/X8WsnDBxxy — TV & Movie Addict 🍿🦋 (@TVMovieAddict) September 16, 2026 Technical issues could have contributed to Conner's ouster.
